tools_used: curl fetch of petitioner's merits brief from supremecourt.gov
pypdf text extraction (via uv run --with pypdf)
helpful: The statpack merits section's per-Term disturbed table with the excluded count made the pooled baseline (359/515 over grant Terms 2017-2024) a two-minute computation.
The provisioned respondent document containing the merits brief (not just the BIO) is exactly what a briefed-moment cell needs.
gaps: The petitioner's merits brief is not provisioned even though the briefed moment is defined by merits briefing being complete; I fetched it from supremecourt.gov myself. Provisioning both merits briefs for evt-brief-judgment cells would save that step.

Both fedcourts query calls returned zero rows (scotus + disposition/era filters); a merits-stage query surface that matches granted-and-decided SCOTUS cases by rule-interpretation subject would be more useful than the cert-shaped filters.
No PDF text extractor (poppler/pdftotext) on the runner; I worked around it with uv run --with pypdf.
notes: documents.json labels the Aug 03 2026 respondent merits brief under kind 'brief-in-opposition' concatenated with the Feb 13 2026 BIO; flagged separately in flags.json.
